_comment: Leave 'discovery.enabled' true and the app will auto-find ONVIF/RTSP cameras on the network at startup (set CAMERA_USER/CAMERA_PASS for the login). To pin specific cameras instead, add them under 'cameras' with enabled:true (that takes priority over discovery), or set the CAMERA_URLS env var. Discovery only finds cameras that already have an IP — a camera on a bare direct cable with no DHCP needs a static IP first (see README).
